Or, store them in the freezer for longer and thaw whenever you’re ready. No fuss. No crust. It’s just The Best Part of the Sandwich, with the yummiest tastes and textures. Each Uncrustables Peanut Butter & Honey Spread Sandwich is made with Unbeatably Soft Bread Baked Fresh in the USA, and packed with creamy peanut butter and smooth, sweet honey spread. An unbeatable combo, with no high fructose corn syrup, no artificial sweeteners and no artificial colors or dyes.
